                                                                                                    Crop Progress
ISSN: 1948-3007


Released October 5, 2026, by the National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS), Agricultural Statistics Board, United States Department of
Agriculture (USDA).



       Special Note

       Due to a lapse in federal funding in October and November 2025, the Crop Progress reports for the weeks ending
       October 5, 2025, through November 9, 2025, were canceled. Therefore, previous year estimates for the
       corresponding weeks will not be available. Five-year average estimates will reflect the years 2021-2025 using
       published estimates for 2021-2024 and imputed estimates for 2025.
